description: Logical calls of RF signal generators (a carrier with a frequency in Hz and a power in dBm, with or without modulation). The application sets the carrier and the output; the modulation formats are added later. Based on the Keysight X-Series (EXG and MXG) manuals.

bool.description: true/false; default text sent to the instrument is ON/OFF unless the library gives a map

modulation_kind.description: modulation format; a model accepts the ones its manual lists (the others are not handled by this model, CALL-002)

modulation_source.description: source of the modulating signal: the first or the second internal generator, or the external input

modulation_shape.description: waveform of an internal modulating generator

coupling.description: coupling of the external modulation input

reset.description: restore the factory defaults (*RST): the RF output goes off

clear_status.description: clear the status registers and the event queue (*CLS)

error_query.description: read and clear the oldest error of the error queue

set_frequency.description: carrier (CW) frequency; the range depends on the model and on its options

set_power_level.description: RF output power level (the level of the RF connector, with the attenuator included); the range depends on the model and on its options

set_output_state.description: switch the RF output on or off (the factory state is off)

query_output_state.description: state of the RF output (true = on)

set_modulation_output_state.description: switch on or off the modulation of the RF output as a whole (the modulation formats keep their own on/off setting)

query_modulation_output_state.description: state of the modulation of the RF output (true = on)

set_modulation_state.description: switch one modulation format on or off (the RF output carries it only if the modulation of the output as a whole, set_modulation_output_state, is on)

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

query_modulation_state.description: state of one modulation format (true = on)

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

set_modulation_source.description: source of the modulating signal of an AM, FM or PM modulation (a single source at a time)

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

set_modulation_rate.description: frequency of an internal modulating generator of an AM, FM or PM modulation

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

query_modulation_rate.description: frequency of an internal modulating generator

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

set_modulation_waveform.description: waveform of the second internal modulating generator of an AM, FM or PM modulation (the manuals document it for that generator)

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

set_modulation_external_coupling.description: coupling of the external input of an AM, FM or PM modulation

kind.description: AM, FM, PM or PULSE (the pulse modulation has only the on/off state)

set_am_depth.description: depth of the amplitude modulation, in percent

query_am_depth.description: depth of the amplitude modulation, in percent

set_fm_deviation.description: peak deviation of the frequency modulation

query_fm_deviation.description: peak deviation of the frequency modulation

set_pm_deviation.description: peak deviation of the phase modulation

query_pm_deviation.description: peak deviation of the phase modulation

operation_complete_query.description: operation complete: returns 1 when the pending operations are finished (*OPC?)

self_test.description: run the instrument self test (*TST?); 0 = pass
